subject: Orbitly Renewal — concession package request
messages:
From: Clara Ng <clara@orbitly.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Li <mli@orbitly.io>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal conversation — budget pressure and ask

Hi Jonas,

Quick context: our Q4 budget was cut by 18% and the renewal for Redwood (RDW-DEAL-2026-3472) is now under review. Marcus and I ran a line-by-line and there are two things we need to surface as blockers for an easy renewal:

- A one-time commercial concession to offset the unexpected budget gap (we're looking at something in the 20–30% range)
- A contractual term tweak so we can align payments to our fiscal calendar (move renewal date +12 months)

We like the product and SLA performance has been solid, but procurement needs a clear concession to avoid putting the service on the next vendor shortlist. Can you share what room you have for a one-time credit and whether a term reset is possible without legal complexity?

Attached: procurement_renewal_request.pdf (procurement spreadsheet, current license list).

Thanks — appreciate a candid reply,
Clara Ng
Head of Procurement, Orbitly
clara@orbitly.io

Hi Clara,

Thanks for the clear background and the attachment — makes sense. I'm sorry to hear about the budget cut. I'd like to propose a short plan:

1) I'll escalate an ask to my manager and Finance for a one-time concession and a 12‑month term reset.
2) If we can agree on a one-time credit + short SLA enhancement for six months, I think we can keep Orbitly on the platform and avoid a procurement bake-off.
3) I'll follow up with a concrete, signed offer (DocuSign) within 48–72 hours if leadership approves.

I've attached a draft mutual action plan (rdw_draft_map_v1.docx) so we can align dates and milestones. I copied Marcus so your procurement and finance folks are in the loop.

Talk soon,

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: (none)
Date: Sun, 16 Aug 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Escalation: request approval for non-standard concession for Orbitly renewal (RDW-DEAL-2026-3472)

Team —

Orbitly (customer) just told me their Q4 budget was reduced by ~18%. They are prepared to re-commit if we provide a concession. Key numbers / ask below:

- Current ARR: $620k (annualized for contract that renews 2026-11-15)
- Renewal term: 12 months standard
- Customer asks: 25% one-time credit off renewal invoice + term reset to align to their fiscal calendar (+12 months). Also requests complimentary SLA "premium" (faster incident response window) for 6 months as a trust gesture.

My recommendation: Approve up to a 15% one-time credit + SLA add-on for 6 months + term reset (12 months). Anything beyond 15% materially reduces our renewal economics and would require exec-level approval.

Rationale: Orbitly is a mid-market prospect with strategic footprint across APAC customers (they originate some downstream referrals). Churn would produce a notable bucket of headwind for Q4 revenue. Risks of over-conceding: sets a pricing precedent for similar accounts in the segment.

Request: Can you confirm approval for the 15% one-time credit + SLA add-on + term reset? If you think we should move higher, please advise and I will prepare the executive justification and P&L impact.

Deal link: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/3472
Deal id: RDW-DEAL-2026-3472

Attachments: rdw_draft_map_v1.docx (proposal draft).

Thanks,
Jonas

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 16 Aug 2026 13:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Escalation: request approval for non-standard concession for Orbitly renewal (RDW-DEAL-2026-3472)

Jonas —

Appreciate the clear ask and the context. I approve the following, conditional on Legal and Finance signoff:

- One-time credit: 15% off the renewal invoice (one-time).
- Term reset: yes, move the renewal date +12 months so Orbitly aligns with their fiscal year. Legal to prepare an amendment (Kim, can you draft language and advise on any material implications?).
- SLA premium: approve complimentary "SLA Premium" (2x faster P1 response) for 6 months as goodwill.

Finance (Dev) — please confirm the ARR impacts and whether the credit requires a revenue deferral accounting treatment that will affect Q4. If there's a material hit > $30k, notify me and we'll decide whether to elevate to CFO for signoff.

Vivek — flagging you in case leadership wants to increase concession beyond 15%. If Orbitly pushes to < 20% and indicates imminent vendor evaluation, we may consider a one-time additional 5% with exec approval.

Kimberly — please draft the amendment and include a clause that this concession is one-time and not a pricing precedent. Also include standard indemnity language for the term reset.

Jonas: once Legal + Finance confirm, send the final offer to Clara with DocuSign link.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Subject: Final concession proposal — Orbitly renewal (RDW-DEAL-2026-3472)

Hi Clara / Marcus —

Thanks for your patience while we reviewed this on our side. I’m pleased to confirm the following approved package: 

- One-time credit: 15% off the renewal invoice (applied as a single credit at contract execution)
- Term reset: we will move your renewal date +12 months to align with Orbitly's fiscal calendar (amendment included)
- SLA Premium: complimentary accelerated P1 response (target SLA window) for the first 6 months of the new term

I’ve attached the approved offer (approved_offer_redwood.pdf) and included a DocuSign link for the amendment and renewal order: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abc-123-orbitly

Next steps: 
1) Please review the attached offer and the DocuSign packet.
2) Sign the amendment + order via DocuSign.
3) Once signed, finance will apply the credit and your new renewal will be effective on the amended date.

Marissa and Vivek are on copy — thank you to their teams for the quick turnaround. If Orbitly needs an additional 5% concession, we would require executive-level approval and a short note on strategic rationale.

Appreciate the partnership — looking forward to continuing the work together.

Best,
Jonas Weber
